result.report:
Regarding your experiment on screen_min, you recorded 90 nights before and 7 nights after the change. Your sleep quality changed by 0.916, with a confidence interval of 0.378 to 1.415. While this change is unlikely to be noise alone, it is not proof of cause, and because you recorded fewer than 14 nights after the change, there is weak evidence.

Your data from 97 nights shows an average sleep of 8.02 hours and an average quality rating of 6.54. You had 11 short nights and your bedtime varies by 29 minutes. Your sleep debt over the last 7 nights against a 8.0 hour target is 1.07 hours. The habit most linked with worse sleep is bed_hour, with a correlation of -0.297 and a p-value of 0.0045, which is strong evidence of an association.

go to bed 30 minutes earlier

General wellbeing information only, not medical advice. If you have serious or persistent symptoms, see a doctor.
